description: Superfood and supplement brand founded in 2014, selling plant-based blends such as greens, reds and gold juice powders, protein and targeted supplements through its own store, with one of the more established affiliate programs in the wellness niche.

evidence.summary: Lasso's Organifi program listing states a 20% per-sale commission for affiliates promoting its superfood supplements, with applications reviewed over a few days. Other directories report different figures (5% base via FlexOffers, 20-30% via Affiliate Explorer), so the rate should be re-confirmed at sign-up; no fetched source states any cap on earnings, so the cap is recorded as unknown.

Creator Hero's review describes Organifi, established in 2014, as a superfood supplement brand whose affiliate partners get product samples, exclusive promotions and a dedicated account manager, with a base rate of 5% rising to 20% for premium content sites via FlexOffers.

Affiliate Explorer lists Organifi's program as running on Refersion with a 60-day cookie, $50 minimum payout and monthly payment by PayPal or direct deposit, and describes the brand as one of the most affiliate-friendly supplement brands.

name: Organifi

reasons.compensation: Lasso lists 20% per sale, among the higher published rates in the supplement niche, though directories disagree (5% base to 30% reported), so the figure needs re-confirming at sign-up.
reasons.contact_access: Joinable through FlexOffers and Refersion with an application review, but no published partnerships email was found on a fetched page.
reasons.credibility: Operating since 2014 with a large catalog and an affiliate program covered by multiple independent directories.
reasons.niche_fit: Superfood powders and daily wellness supplements are core health-creator content, easy to build routines around.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Applications are open now through public network listings with approval typically within about a week.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A long-running affiliate/ambassador program with samples, exclusive promotions and a dedicated account manager for partners.

description: Austin-based human-performance brand founded by Aubrey Marcus and acquired by Unilever in 2021, selling supplements led by the Alpha BRAIN nootropic, plus functional foods and unconventional fitness equipment, promoted heavily through celebrity and athlete endorsements.

evidence.summary: Onnit's official affiliate page states the program runs on Impact, applications are reviewed within 72 hours, and 'we have a very limited number of spots available for program acceptance' — direct evidence the creator pool is deliberately kept small.

The Affiliate Monkey's program breakdown states Onnit pays 15% of the sale amount on regular products plus $10 per sale on specific product trials (Alpha BRAIN, Total Human and others) via Impact Radius, with a 45-day cookie. Lasso lists 12% and Creator Hero 10%, so the exact rate should be confirmed in the Impact marketplace; no fetched source states an earnings cap.

The Affiliates List notes Onnit was founded by Aubrey Marcus and acquired by Unilever in 2021, requires an established fitness website or at least 5,000 engaged followers to apply, and pays 15% per sale plus a $10 trial bounty on a 45-day cookie.

name: Onnit

reasons.compensation: Most detailed listings report 15% on regular products plus a $10 bounty on trial products via Impact, though some directories list 10-12%, so confirm in the marketplace.
reasons.contact_access: A dedicated official program page with an application and a named program manager follow-up, but no published email.
reasons.credibility: Major performance brand owned by Unilever since 2021, with celebrity and pro-athlete endorsements.
reasons.niche_fit: Nootropics, supplements and functional training gear sit squarely in the health and biohacking creator niche.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Applications are open, but the brand states spots are very limited and reviewers look for an established platform.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A structured Impact program built around creators and endorsers, with application review inside 72 hours per the official page.

description: Red light therapy company that pioneered full-body at-home light therapy panels, selling modular devices (Mini, Solo and larger setups) for recovery, skin and sleep, with both a paid affiliate program and a separate unpaid brand ambassador program.

evidence.summary: Joovv's official Affiliate Terms state verbatim that affiliates earn 'a commission of 8% of all JOOVV red light therapy devices that was purchased through your Link', with customers getting a $50 discount via the affiliate link or code, and commissions payable 90 days after purchase. The terms contain no statement capping total earnings, so the cap is recorded as unknown.

Joovv's official affiliate page invites creators, patients-facing professionals and clients-focused partners to apply, and promises a reply within 48 hours if the applicant is a good fit — a manually reviewed, application-based program.

The same page states that before Joovv, full-body light therapy treatments at home were nonexistent and the brand has become 'the go-to source for all things light therapy', supporting its category-pioneer positioning.

name: Joovv

reasons.compensation: A published 8% commission in the brand's own affiliate terms — modest, but on high-priced devices, and customers get $50 off through the affiliate link.
reasons.contact_access: An official application page plus a published support email (help@joovv.com) in the affiliate terms — above mid-range per the rubric.
reasons.credibility: Category pioneer in at-home full-body light therapy with a long operating history and clinical-study partnerships.
reasons.niche_fit: Recovery, sleep and skin light therapy is a strong fit for wellness and biohacking creators, though it is a narrower niche than supplements.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Applications are open now with a promised 48-hour reply for good fits, subject to manual review.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Both a paid affiliate program with formal terms and a separate brand ambassador program built around creator content.
